run_fuse_gtest_files: run fuse_gtest_files.py to merge all Google Test source files into a single header and source file
run_fuse_gtest_with_root: run fuse_gtest_files.py with a custom GTEST_ROOT_DIR and OUTPUT_DIR to fuse gtest into a new location
fuse_gtest_h: fuse all gtest header files recursively into a single gtest.h output file
fuse_gtest_all_cc: fuse all gtest source files recursively into a single gtest-all.cc output file
validate_gtest_root_dir: validate that a given directory contains the required gtest seed files before fusing
